parole.significato: native or resident of Azov (a village in Ukraine)
parole.testo: From Азо́в (Azóv) + -ець (-ecʹ), in turn derived from Kipchak azaq (“lowlands”). Compare with Polish azowiec and Russian азо́вец (azóvec). The military brigade was named after the Sea of Azov as it was originally from Mariupol, which is located near that sea.
From a diminutive (compare Turkish -çık) of Kipchak قمچی (kamçı), from Ottoman Turkish قامچی (kamçı). Compare Russian камча́ (kamčá) and камчу́г (kamčúg), Polish kańczug.
